summary.headline: Planetary Changes Altering Inceptions
summary.text: Astrological rules for identifying people who will arrive from planets entering signs, including how multiple or bicorporeal signs affect the count. An example of an altered military undertaking shows Mars entering Sagittarius, afflicting the ascendant by square while the action’s lord turns away from Jupiter.
